about: Computed offline from the made-up SharkCam catch table (not field data). Task: species from length, weight, girth, depth, temperature and month, with the models of the t8 results table. a is one character per record in catch.csv order: hold-out 0 training, 1 validation, 2 test; k-fold the fold number (0 to 9, characters 0-9). Plain shuffles use RandomState(seed).
